OG HQ
Established in Quays · 2023 · Still Going Strong

The OG was formed in Quays in 2023, after what was presumably a very important meeting that nobody bothered to document.

We are a strictly limited-edition 3-member gang:

Anand
The Boss. The final decision-maker. The man whose decisions we respectfully pretend were our idea all along.
Ashi
OG member. Present, loyal and apparently still employed by the gang.
Mahi
OG member. Founding-level chaos, fully certified.

Anand is the boss, and we always respect him. This is not up for discussion. The OG constitution has spoken. 😌

We also currently have one intern inside the organisation: Febin Ashiq. The role is unpaid, the benefits are questionable, and the performance review is basically just “good job” in the WhatsApp group.

🚫 WE ARE NOT HIRING Currently, the OG has no vacancies, no open positions and absolutely no recruitment drive. Please do not send us messages or emails asking about jobs. Our HR department is on permanent leave.
